usage: Every NFL team's bye week and per-scoring-period opponent, keyed by ESPN pro team id. Use this instead of web research for byes and opponents; it is the same snapshot as the rosters. A scoring period absent from a team's games_by_scoring_period is that team's bye, which is why bye_week and the gap always agree. Every player record in rosters.json, player_index.json and recent_form_rankings.json already carries bye_week inline, so only the opponent lookup needs this file. kickoff_ct is the kickoff in US Central.
